attempts.note: First layout: tb, five layers, single vertical spine (worker->runtime->engine->backend->container), filesystem/blobnet in a second column, daemon in a third. extent 64x37, 0 crossings, 0 detours, 8/8 origins, but labels reported 1 ambiguous owner (warning).

Identical geometry; one label shortened: backend->container from 'runs user process' (17 chars) to 'runs process' (12). At 17 chars the label anchored 9 cells from its own route while the engine->backend run sat 8 cells away, so no unambiguous slot existed at that length; at 12 chars the anchor clears its own route by 7 cells. All other lines unchanged.

Tried to clear the control palette off the bottom-left node by reserving an empty leading column (extent 64 -> 68). The check stayed clean, but a frame dump proved the drawn coordinates were unchanged: the view fits and centres on the node bounding box (63 columns wide, offset 7 in a 77-column pane), so an empty column at the edge is absorbed by the centring and does not move any box. Palette overlap therefore unfixed.
attempts.verdict: rejected: no visible change, palette overlap remains
